# Icosahedral Jacobi numerical branch tests — v1

The edge branch of the exact Jacobi sextic was continued numerically from beta=0.
For each point we checked:

1. the sextic equation;
2. equality of the universal pullbacks X(m)=X_I(beta);
3. the exact normalized period-ratio formula.

This is provisional numerical evidence for the selected local branch; it is not a substitute for the direct sphere-coordinate map.
